app.name: AlienFX Tools
app.one_liner: A lightweight suite for direct hardware control of Alienware lighting, fans, and power profiles without AWCC.

screens.name: AlienFX Control Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central interface for managing lighting zones, fan speeds, power modes, and monitoring system health.
primary_actions: Adjust fan curves or set fixed RPM

screens.name: Settings Panel
screens.purpose: Configure tool behavior, startup options, sensor sources, and privilege requirements.
primary_actions: Select BIOS vs EC sensor source

rust_commands.name: apply_lighting_profile
rust_commands.purpose: Apply a configured lighting effect or profile to connected AlienFX devices using direct USB HID commands.

rust_commands.name: probe_hardware_devices
rust_commands.purpose: Detect connected AlienFX-compatible lighting and thermal devices through USB and ACPI enumeration.

rust_commands.name: set_fan_curve
rust_commands.purpose: Send fan control commands via ACPI BIOS function calls to adjust fan speeds based on temperature or manual input.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build basic ACPI fan command dispatcher using BIOS function calls
week 1: Create device probing logic for known Alienware models
week 1: Design main screen UI with zone-based lighting editor
week 1: Implement core USB HID communication layer for lighting control
week 2: Add profile switching based on application launch or power state
week 2: Add tray tooltip showing fan RPM percent and thermal status
week 2: Implement settings panel with admin-gated options
week 2: Integrate system monitoring for CPU/GPU temp into lighting effects
acceptance_tests: Fan control adjusts RPM via ACPI BIOS calls without direct EC access and respects BIOS safety limits
GUI disables AWCC service when 'Disable AWCC' is enabled (requires UAC approval)
LightFX emulation allows legacy Dell LightFX games to control system lighting
On Alienware m15 R1, lighting effects update at ≥60cps without AWCC running
Tool starts correctly at Windows login with proper working directory and detects all lighting zones
